name: electrobun-plugin-root
description: Workspace root for electrobun-plugin (Claude Code plugin) + electrobun-devtools (npm slice). Not published.

scripts.graphify:self: bash -c 'cd $(pwd) && python -c "from graphify.detect import detect; from pathlib import Path; import json; r = detect(Path(\"src\")); print(json.dumps(r, indent=2))"'
